title: WorkItemEvent - Data API
description: Represents real-time notifications for work item status changes in a DevOps Center project. This object is available in API version 66.0 and later.

EventUuid.description: The universally unique identifier (UUID) for the event.

NewStatus.description: The work item status after the lifecycle update, such as Ready to Promote or Promoted.

OldStatus.description: The work item status before the lifecycle update, such as In Progress.

Project.description: The ID of the project that contains the work item.

ReplayId.description: The event bus replay ID. Subscribers can use this value to replay event messages within the retention window.

WorkItemName.description: The name of the work item. For example, WI-000001.

wsdl_segment:
```xml
<simpleType name="ID">
  <restriction base="xsd:string">
    <length value="18"/>
    <pattern value="[a-zA-Z0-9]{18}"/>
  </restriction>
</simpleType>
<complexType name="WorkItemEvent">
  <complexContent>
    <extension base="ens:sObject">
      <sequence>
        <element name="CreatedBy" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="ens:User"/>
        <element name="CreatedById" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID"/>
        <element name="CreatedDate" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime"/>
        <element name="EventUuid" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="NewStatus" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="OldStatus" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="Project" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="ReplayId" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="WorkItemName" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
      </sequence>
    </extension>
  </complexContent>
</complexType>
```
